# harness-core

> Kimi product harness built on @moonshot-ai/agent-core: the kernel Unit
> runtime and createApp/createFeature seam (createApp + AgentRuntime),
> 44 product features as createFeature units,
> and HTTP/ACP/remote-control transports. agent-core provides the loop
> machine, the session domain, the LLM stack, and the store/blob layer.

Import conventions: `@moonshot-ai/harness-core` has a root export; inside
the package the runtime seam is imported as `#/app/index` / `#/composition-api/index`
(externally: `@moonshot-ai/harness-core/app/index` / `.../composition-api/index`).
`@moonshot-ai/agent-core` is subpath-only (`.../session/index`,
`.../loop/index`, `.../store/index`, `.../blob/index`, `.../tool/index`,
`.../history/index`, `.../llm/*`).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): package orientation, documentation map, import conventions.
- [Architecture](explanation/architecture.md): layers (agent-core vs harness-core), the three-level createFeature mechanism, features.add scope rules, facade tokens, EventContext-enriched event bubbling, and the dispose/remount re-entrancy discipline.
- [Persistence](explanation/persistence.md): agent loop logs (LoopRecord), the session roster log, feature events sharing those same logs via useFeatureStore with single-rewind undo, blobs, and the nodeSessionSpace directory layout.
- [Agent Runtime](explanation/agent-runtime.md): the AgentRuntime record (tool registry, host prompt section), ensureAgent, the loop's requester primitive and native policy registry, the agent-core system prompt sections contribution point, setTools freeze/retry semantics, and provider-catalog managed model binding.
- [Contribution Hooks](reference/contribution-hooks.md): every hook a feature unit can call — harness runtime hooks, agent-core loop hook helpers, kernel hooks — one line each with its module.
- [Events](reference/events.md): every event reachable via app.on — built-in app/unit events, forwarded log commits, and each feature's declared event union; notes which old-world events are gone.
- [Facades](reference/facades.md): every facade token exposed by features and transports, one line each.
- [Run a Turn](how-to-guides/01-run-a-turn.md): createApp + features.add + app.open + ensureAgent + requester + runTurn, end to end.
- [Develop a Feature](how-to-guides/02-develop-a-feature.md): createFeature anatomy — levels, props, facade, events, tools, feature store, remount-safe setup, and the memory-space + scripted-requester test pattern.
- [Persist Feature State](how-to-guides/03-persist-feature-state.md): useFeatureStore scope/projection/dispatch semantics and the single-rewind session.undo.
- [Serve HTTP](how-to-guides/04-serve-http.md): createHttp options, the route-builtin/route-features/route-v2 layers, custom routes via useHttpRoute, and facade consumption in handlers.

## Key Source Entry Points

- `src/composition-api/`: the Unit runtime on @vue/reactivity — createUnit/mountRoot, tokens, setup hooks.
- `src/app/`: createApp + createFeature + AppUnit/SessionUnit/AgentUnit, useApp/useSession/useAgent, useSystemPrompt.
- `src/app/app.ts`: createApp over a plain SessionSpace.
- `src/app/session.ts`: AppSession — the session handler: ensureAgent/forkAgent, agentRuntime, the per-session runtime registry.
- `src/runtime/agents.ts`: AgentRuntime, agentCaps, ensureAgent options, syncAgentTools.
- `src/app/hooks.ts`: useAgentTools/useMessageResolver/useLlmRecovery/useLlmRetryable/useLoopEvent/useBlobs/useWaitForTasks.
- `src/app/stores.ts`: useFeatureStore, FeatureStore, FeatureEvent.
- `src/presets/`: base.ts createDefaultApp (full product feature set); createDefaultHttp / createDefaultAcp return the app with the transport (HTTP + remote-control, or ACP) mounted.
- `src/features/<name>/feature.ts`: each feature's createFeature definition (facade tokens, event unions, props).
- `src/feature-http/feature.ts`: createHttp; `src/feature-http/scope.ts`: useHttpRoute, sessionFacade/agentFacade.
- `example/app.ts`: full assembly of a product host; `example/cli.ts`: running a turn.

## Related

- `packages/agent-core/AGENTS.md`: authoritative index of the engine architecture (loop, session, store, blob, llm, tool).
- `packages/agent-core/docs/`: LLM boundary, request lifecycle, input contract, errors/retries, and loop/session how-tos.
